scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/baucua.js && node --check public/bootstrap.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/generate-assets.mjs && npm run build && node --check dist/game.js && node scripts/check-build.mjs
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.d1.toml
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.toml
scripts.deploy:d1: npm run build && npm run db:remote && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.d1.toml

DB.description: Optional D1 database for 8-digit cloud backup codes. Core gameplay works without it.
